name: Dropdown
description: The APG combobox, in both shapes: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/

props.name: name
props.description: What the selection submits under: the component renders a hidden input carrying it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: What is selected to begin with, when the dropdown owns its own value. An array in `multiple` mode.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection. Pair it with `onChange`, or nothing the user picks sticks.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Let more than one option be chosen. Enter and Space then toggle without closing the listbox.

props.name: isSearchable
props.description: Turn the control into the APG *editable* combobox: a text field that filters the listbox, and a different pattern rather than a decoration — the field carries the role, the ARIA and your `props`. Printable keys type instead of jumping, Home/End and left/right move the caret, and Escape closes the listbox before it clears the field.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: The placeholder for the `isSearchable` field. Not a name — see `label`.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Drop the chevron. It is decoration either way: it is `aria-hidden` and never focusable.

props.name: showCheckbox
props.description: Show checkbox for each item in multiple selection mode

props.name: label
props.description: The dropdown's name, rendered above it and pointed at by `aria-labelledby`. A combobox is not named by what it contains — accname does not read a combobox at all, and the trigger text is its *value* — so without this (or your own `aria-label`) it has no accessible name.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Styles for the wrapper the label and the trigger share. Only rendered when there is a label.

props.name: itemsProps
props.description: BoxProps applied to the opened items container (dropdown.items)

props.name: iconProps
props.description: BoxProps applied to the chevron icon container (dropdown.icon)

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the value chosen (`undefined` when it was unselected) and the full selection beside it.

props.name: children
props.description: What the trigger shows: a node, or a function given the selected values and whether it is open.

keyboard.action: Opens, with the highlight on the selected option — or on the first or last when nothing is chosen.
Opens. The browser's own activation is suppressed, so it does not shut again.
Opens at the first or the last option.
Opens with the first option starting with it already highlighted.
Moves the highlight, wrapping at the ends and skipping disabled options.
Jumps to the first or last option.
Typeahead. A longer buffer narrows; the same letter twice cycles through the options sharing it.
Chooses the highlighted option and closes. In `multiple` mode it toggles and stays open.
Chooses the highlighted option and closes.
Closes, changing nothing. Focus never left the trigger, so nothing is restored.
Chooses the highlighted option, then moves on to the next control.
Types into the field, which opens the listbox and filters it. No typeahead — the field owns the keys.
Opens, or moves the highlight through what the filter left, wrapping and skipping disabled options.
Move the caret, and hand the highlight back to the field: no option is where you are any more.
Types a space. Only Enter chooses in this mode.
Chooses the highlighted option and puts its text in the field. With nothing highlighted it does nothing.
Closes the listbox, keeping what was typed. Pressed again on a closed one, it clears the field.

a11y: `role="combobox"` with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `aria-activedescendant` on the trigger, and `role="listbox"`/`role="option"` with `aria-selected` on the popup.
Nothing names a combobox for you — accname does not read its contents, and the trigger text is its *value* — so pass `label`, or an `aria-label` of your own in `props`.
DOM focus never leaves the trigger (or, when searchable, the field), so no option is a tab stop and the popup can be portalled without stranding the keyboard inside it.
